words.English Meaning: to want / to miss / to think
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我想学习流利的普通话。(Wǒ xiǎng xuéxí liúlì de pǔtōnghuà.) — I want to learn fluent Mandarin.
明天我要参加一场考试。(Míngtiān wǒ yào cānjiā yì chǎng kǎoshì.) — Tomorrow I need to take an exam.

words.English Meaning: can / to know how to / will
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 你会说中文和法语吗？(Nǐ huì shuō zhōngwén hé fǎyǔ ma?) — Can you speak Chinese and French?

words.English Meaning: can / to be able to / may
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 你能帮我拿一下行李吗？(Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ná yíxià xíngli ma?) — Can you help me carry the luggage?
请问我可以坐这里吗？(Qǐngwèn wǒ kěyǐ zuò zhèlǐ ma?) — Excuse me, may I sit here?

words.English Meaning: to like / to be fond of
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我非常喜欢看书和跑步。(Wǒ fēicháng xǐhuan kànshū hé pǎobù.) — I like reading and running very much.
我们深爱着我们的家人。(Wǒmen shēn'ài zhe wǒmen de jiārén.) — We deeply love our family.

words.English Meaning: to feel / to think / to consider
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 我觉得这套卡片很有帮助。(Wǒ juéde zhè tào kǎpiàn hěn yǒu bāngzhù.) — I think this flashcard set is very helpful.
听到这个好消息大家都很高兴。(Tīngdào zhè gè hǎo xiāoxi dàjiā dōu hěn gāoxìng.) — Everyone is happy hearing this good news.
祝大家新年快乐，万事如意！(Zhù dàjiā xīnnián kuàilè, wànshì rúyì!) — Wish everyone a Happy New Year and all the best!
今天工作了一整天，感觉很累。(Jīntiān gōngzuò le yì zhěng tiān, gǎnjué hěn lèi.) — Worked all day today, feeling very tired.
我肚子有点饿了，去吃点东西吧。(Wǒ dùzi yǒudiǎn è le, qù chī diǎn dōngxi ba.) — I'm feeling a bit hungry, let's go eat something.
打完球以后大家都很渴。(Dǎ wán qiú yǐhòu dàjiā dōu hěn kě.) — After playing ball, everyone was very thirsty.
今天天气凉爽，感觉很舒服。(Jīntiān tiānqì liángshuǎng, gǎnjué hěn shūfu.) — Cool weather today, feels very comfortable.

words.English Meaning: to fall ill / to get sick
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 天气变冷要注意保暖，别生病了。(Tiānqì biàn lěng yào zhùyì bǎonuǎn, bié shēngbìng le.) — Keep warm as weather turns cold, don't get sick.
我嗓子有点疼。(Wǒ sǎngzi yǒudiǎn téng.) — My throat is a little sore.

words.English Meaning: cold / flu / to catch a cold
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 他感冒了，需要多喝热水。(Tā gǎnmào le, xūyào duō hē rè shuǐ.) — He caught a cold and needs to drink more hot water.
谢谢你耐心的帮助。(Xièxie nǐ nàixīn de bāngzhù.) — Thank you for your patient help.
这句话我听懂了。(Zhè jù huà wǒ tīng dǒng le.) — I understood this sentence.
你明白这个语法规则了吗？(Nǐ míngbai zhè gè yǔfǎ guīzé le ma?) — Do you understand this grammar rule?
你知道去机场的路怎么走吗？(Nǐ zhīdào qù jīchǎng de lù zěnme zǒu ma?) — Do you know the route to the airport?
你在中国认识很多新朋友吗？(Nǐ zài Zhōngguó rènshi hěn duō xīn péngyou ma?) — Did you get to know many new friends in China?
坚持每天学习中文。(Jiānchí měitiān xuéxí zhōngwén.) — Persevere in studying Chinese every day.
希望你学习进步，一切顺利！(Xīwàng nǐ xuéxí jìnbù, yíqiè shùnlì!) — Hope you make good study progress and all goes smoothly!

words.English Meaning: to wish / to express good wishes
words.Example (Chinese + Pinyin): 祝你旅途愉快！(Zhù nǐ lǚtú yúkuài!) — Wish you a pleasant journey!
